name: DHT sensor library
author: Adafruit
description: Reads temperature and humidity from DHT11 and DHT22 sensors.

entries.label: DHT
entries.info: Creates a DHT sensor object: DHT dht(pin, DHT22);

entries.label: Servo
entries.info: Creates a servo object: Servo myServo;

name: Adafruit NeoPixel
author: Adafruit
description: Controls WS2812 and other addressable RGB LEDs.

entries.label: Adafruit_NeoPixel
entries.info: Creates a strip object: Adafruit_NeoPixel strip(count, pin, NEO_GRB + NEO_KHZ800);

entries.label: NEO_GRB
entries.info: Pixels are wired for GRB color order.

entries.label: NEO_KHZ800
entries.info: 800 KHz bitstream, used by most WS2812 LEDs.

name: PubSubClient
author: Nick O'Leary
description: MQTT client for sending and receiving messages.

entries.label: PubSubClient
entries.info: Creates an MQTT client: PubSubClient client(wifiClient);

name: ArduinoJson
author: Benoit Blanchon
description: Parses and builds JSON on small devices.

entries.label: JsonDocument
entries.info: Holds a JSON document in memory.

entries.label: deserializeJson
entries.info: Parses JSON text into a document.

entries.label: serializeJson
entries.info: Writes a document as JSON text.

name: LiquidCrystal I2C

description: Drives character LCD displays over I2C.

entries.label: LiquidCrystal_I2C
